candidate_program.name: global_greedy_marginal
candidate_program.rationale: Compares greedy root-included and root-excluded completion estimates using a root-scale normalized margin. This reaches remote residual structure; two global greedy computations per candidate may dominate total CPU, and their difference is approximate.
candidate_program.rule: (weight + take_greedy - skip_greedy) / (1 + weight + conflict_weight / (1 + degree)) + 0.05 * weight / (1 + weight + conflict_weight)

comparison: exact rational comparison of returned binary float scores
cost_scope: Cached offline score-fit evaluation only; does not replace complete-schedule charged cost
